scope: Three new external unit controls. Production C2/C5, field-limit widening, protection and raw native record persistence/reversal are executed. A proposal-only post-C5 limit is called in the test helper for one known matched pair. No production operator is changed and no project analysis is run.

notation.rawNormalRecords: Unchanged; persist the original raw NORMAL result before the proposed C5 output cap.

C2Bound.sourceLaw: RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit/canEmitInitial admit the demanded prefix or stop after the first new counted field under an ANY demand. Therefore depth(A)<=depth(D_c)+1. Abstract EXACT-to-STAR summary normalization keeps the path length.
C2Bound.executedCell: D_c=ret.[any]/T, submitted=ret.f.$/T -> A=ret.f.$/T, depth 1. N and D submitted layers are both tested.

deeperCurrentC5.currentResult: arg0.a.b.c.$/T is retained at depth 3; its supplied NORMAL or DEMAND layer is preserved.
deeperCurrentC5.proposedResult: Per matched D_p depth 0, cap 1 yields arg0.a.[any]/T DEMAND.
deeperCurrentC5.protection: Both unprotected and protected variants pass. The existing limit operation transports the protection mask into the coarse result.
deeperCurrentC5.exactExitNegative: D_p exact at depths 0,1,2 already rejects this deeper descendant in current C5. This cap targets suffix-permitting exits.

packedExample.scope: Logical AP leaf counts in one publication; no project speedup or retained-heap reduction is measured.

rawNativeControl.selectedPolicy: The proposal helper cuts only the C5 result. RunSummaryStore retains raw B unchanged. Current PersistentRecordStore.persist reads raw summaries.
rawNativeControl.normalRaw: The depth-3 NORMAL raw relation remains one native record even while its proposed current publication is depth-1 DEMAND.
rawNativeControl.replay: The existing opposite-direction native view still accepts an exact NORMAL arg0.a.b.c/T actual and produces exact NORMAL ret.f/T. This is executed with the current applyRecordLeaf path.
rawNativeControl.demandRaw: A raw DEMAND relation remains ineligible for native persistence (zero saved rows), as before.

layerSelectionIntegration.currentSource: RunMethodAnalyzer.queuePublications computes selected from raw facts before calling published/C5, then uses that Boolean to decide addDemand for every piece.
layerSelectionIntegration.necessaryDesignChangeIfSelected: A new N-to-D C5 cut invalidates that current layer-preservation assumption. Outgoing demand selection must account for each new capped result or its new refinement guidance can be lost.
layerSelectionIntegration.status: Design obligation only; no production change is made.

pairedHelperProgress.code: Root make(Object p){Mid tmp=new Mid();tmp.b=p;Root r=new Root();r.a=tmp;return r;} Object take(Root q){Mid tmp=q.a;return tmp.b;}
pairedHelperProgress.oldState: At global budget 1, make publishes ret.a.[any]/T DEMAND and backward take publishes arg0.a.[any]/T DEMAND.
pairedHelperProgress.oppositeEndpoint: The old middle initial a.[any] has depth 1 and becomes D_p in the next opposite guide.
pairedHelperProgress.newWriter: At global budget 2, raw make retains ret.a.b.$/T NORMAL. Its matched D_p=ret.a.[any] has depth 1, so cap 2 preserves that precise NORMAL current publication despite the writer original premise remaining depth 0.
pairedHelperProgress.readerRefinement: That precise current actual refines the reader ANY guide into depth-2 exact NORMAL initial. Forward take yields root exact NORMAL result.
pairedHelperProgress.symmetricBackward: The backward reader also publishes a precise depth-2 NORMAL result through its depth-1 D_p; make then starts a depth-2 exact initial and produces the root exact NORMAL source requirement.
pairedHelperProgress.scope: This removes the previous original-premise+1 local fixed point. It is not a general cross-iteration completeness or termination proof and not a full-driver finding experiment.

depthRecurrence.handoff: The next opposite demand swaps the new endpoints: D_p_next=A, D_c_next=B. Its budget can grow through the refined opposite initial, instead of remaining anchored to one shallow current original.
depthRecurrence.caution: These are upper bounds, not strict progress. Intrinsic ANY facts and source/ND/Target obligations still need separate proofs.

package org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi

import org.opentaint.dataflow.ap.ifds.AccessPathBase
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.ap.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.fixtures.MethodAnalysisFixtures
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.interp.starEdge
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.store.*
import kotlin.test.*

/** Proposal-only post-C5 collector. No production cut, persistence or C5 code is replaced. */
class DemandRelativeIntersectionProbeTest {
    private val p=AccessPathBase.Argument(0)
    private val ret=AccessPathBase.Return
    private val tmp=AccessPathBase.LocalVar(0)
    private val obj=AccessPathBase.LocalVar(1)
    private fun cut(f:MethodAnalysisFixtures,raw:Facts,limit:Int):Facts {
        val out=CollectingOut();f.ops.limit(raw,limit,out);return out.results.single()
    }
    private fun relative(f:MethodAnalysisFixtures,raw:Facts,dp:Pattern,global:Int):Facts =
        cut(f,raw,minOf(global,dp.fact.path.count(Int::isCounted)+1))
    private fun guide(f:MethodAnalysisFixtures,dc:Pattern,dp:Pattern)=DemandStore.Builder(f.manager).apply {
        add(f.key,DemandPattern(dc,dp))
    }.build()
    private fun desc(f:MethodAnalysisFixtures,facts:Facts):String {
        val leaf=f.ops.leaves(facts).single()
        return "${leaf.fact.base}:${leaf.fact.path.size}/${leaf.fact.tail}/${facts.layer}"
    }

    @Test fun `C2 grows by one field but current broad-exit C5 retains three fields`() {
        for(layer in Layer.entries)for(protected in listOf(false,true))MethodAnalysisFixtures().use { f ->
            val t=MarkSlot.Concrete(f.mark("T"));val field=f.field("f")
            val path=listOf(f.field("a"),f.field("b"),f.field("c"));val global=4
            val dc=f.pattern(ret,tail=Tail.ANY,mark=t)
            val dp=f.pattern(p,tail=Tail.ANY,mark=t)
            val demand=guide(f,dc,dp)
            val policy=RestrictedInitialPolicy(run=4,fieldLimit=global,direction=Direction.BACKWARD,catalog=f.manager.marks)
            val actual=f.fact(ret,listOf(field),mark=t,layer=layer)
            val admitted=demand.initials(f.key,actual,policy).single()
            assertEquals(1,admitted.initial.pathArray.size)
            assertEquals(Tail.EXACT,admitted.initial.tail)
            assertEquals(layer,admitted.layer)
            val plain=f.fact(p,path,mark=t,layer=layer) as TaintTree
            val raw=if(protected)plain.withProtection(plain.root)else plain
            val current=demand.intersect(f.key,admitted.initial,raw,policy).single()
            assertEquals(3,f.ops.leaves(current).single().fact.path.size)
            assertEquals(Tail.EXACT,f.ops.leaves(current).single().fact.tail)
            assertEquals(layer,current.layer)
            val capped=relative(f,current,dp,global)
            assertEquals(1,f.ops.leaves(capped).single().fact.path.size)
            assertEquals(Tail.ANY,f.ops.leaves(capped).single().fact.tail)
            assertEquals(Layer.DEMAND,capped.layer)
            assertEquals(protected,(capped as TaintTree).nonSubsumable!=null)
            val rawSelected=f.ops.demandPart(admitted.initial,raw,Direction.BACKWARD)!=null
            val cappedSelected=f.ops.demandPart(admitted.initial,capped,Direction.BACKWARD)!=null
            assertTrue(cappedSelected)
            if(layer==Layer.NORMAL)assertFalse(rawSelected)
            // R1 continues to read the raw store, not the proposed publication cut.
            val rawStore=RunSummaryStore(f.manager).apply { add(admitted.initial,raw) }
            val records=PersistentRecordStore(f.manager)
            records.persist(Direction.BACKWARD,sequenceOf(f.key to rawStore))
            val saved=records.byExit(f.key,f.ops.leaves(raw).single()).toList()
            assertEquals(if(layer==Layer.NORMAL)1 else 0,saved.size)
            if(layer==Layer.NORMAL) {
                var replayed:Facts?=null
                saved.single().forEachReversedAt(f.ops.leaves(raw).single()) { view,flag ->
                    val out=CollectingOut()
                    f.ops.applyRecordLeaf(f.fact(p,path,mark=t),view,flag,
                        ApMode(false,Direction.FORWARD,global),out,original=f.manager.zero)
                    replayed=out.results.single()
                }
                assertEquals(Layer.NORMAL,replayed!!.layer)
                assertEquals(listOf(field),f.ops.leaves(replayed!!).single().fact.path)
            }
            println("DEMAND_RELATIVE layer=$layer protected=$protected DcDepth=0 DpDepth=0 admittedDepth=1 current=${desc(f,current)} capped=${desc(f,capped)} savedRawNormalRecords=${saved.size} rawSelected=$rawSelected cappedSelected=$cappedSelected")
        }
    }

    @Test fun `exact exit already rejects descendants while broad exit depth controls a proposed postcut`() {
        MethodAnalysisFixtures().use { f ->
            val t=MarkSlot.Concrete(f.mark("T"));val field=f.field("f")
            val path=listOf(f.field("a"),f.field("b"),f.field("c"));val global=4
            val dc=f.pattern(ret,tail=Tail.ANY,mark=t)
            val policy=RestrictedInitialPolicy(run=4,fieldLimit=global,direction=Direction.BACKWARD,catalog=f.manager.marks)
            val initial=f.manager.initial(f.pattern(ret,listOf(field),mark=t))
            val raw=f.fact(p,path,mark=t)
            for(depth in 0..2)assertTrue(guide(f,dc,f.pattern(p,path.take(depth),mark=t)).intersect(f.key,initial,raw,policy).isEmpty())
            for(depth in 0..3) {
                val dp=f.pattern(p,path.take(depth),Tail.ANY,t)
                val current=guide(f,dc,dp).intersect(f.key,initial,raw,policy).single()
                val capped=relative(f,current,dp,global)
                println("EXIT_DEPTH DpDepth=$depth current=${desc(f,current)} capped=${desc(f,capped)}")
                assertEquals(minOf(3,depth+1),f.ops.leaves(capped).single().fact.path.size)
                assertEquals(if(depth>=2)Layer.NORMAL else Layer.DEMAND,capped.layer)
            }
            val dp=f.pattern(p,tail=Tail.ANY,mark=t)
            val forest=(0 until 4).flatMap { i->(0 until 4).map { j->
                f.fact(p,listOf(path[0],f.field("b$i"),f.field("c$j")),mark=t)
            } }.reduce { a,b->f.manager.mergeAddDelta(a,b).first }
            val current=guide(f,dc,dp).intersect(f.key,initial,forest,policy).single()
            val capped=relative(f,current,dp,global)
            assertEquals(16,f.ops.leaves(current).count())
            assertEquals(1,f.ops.leaves(capped).count())
            println("PACKED_C5 beforeLeaves=${f.ops.leaves(current).count()} afterLeaves=${f.ops.leaves(capped).count()} beforeLayer=${current.layer} afterLayer=${capped.layer}")
        }
    }

    private fun transfer(f:MethodAnalysisFixtures,seed:AdmittedInitial,edges:List<PathEdge>,global:Int,direction:Direction):Facts {
        val mode=ApMode(false,direction,global)
        var facts=f.ops.startFact(seed.initial,mode)
        facts=facts.withLayer(facts.layer or(seed.layer==Layer.DEMAND))
        for(edge in edges) {
            val out=CollectingOut();f.ops.applyEdge(facts,seed.initial,edge,true,mode,out)
            facts=cut(f,out.results.single(),global)
        }
        return facts
    }
    private fun bind(f:MethodAnalysisFixtures,facts:Facts,to:AccessPathBase,global:Int):Facts {
        val out=CollectingOut();f.ops.applyEdge(facts,f.manager.zero,
            starEdge(facts.base,emptyList(),to,emptyList()),false,ApMode(false,Direction.FORWARD,global),out)
        return out.results.single()
    }
    @Test fun `matched opposite premise depth breaks the earlier two-helper fixed point without native replay`() {
        MethodAnalysisFixtures().use { f ->
            val t=MarkSlot.Concrete(f.mark("T"));val a=f.field("a");val b=f.field("b")
            val make=listOf(starEdge(p,emptyList(),tmp,listOf(b)),starEdge(tmp,emptyList(),obj,listOf(a)),starEdge(obj,emptyList(),ret,emptyList()))
            val take=listOf(starEdge(p,listOf(a),tmp,emptyList()),starEdge(tmp,listOf(b),ret,emptyList()))
            val pRoot=f.pattern(p,mark=t);val retRoot=f.pattern(ret,mark=t)
            val writerSeed=AdmittedInitial(f.manager.initial(pRoot),Layer.NORMAL)
            val readerSeed=AdmittedInitial(f.manager.initial(retRoot),Layer.NORMAL)
            val oldWriter=transfer(f,writerSeed,make,1,Direction.FORWARD)
            val oldReader=transfer(f,readerSeed,take.asReversed().map { revEdge(it)!! },1,Direction.BACKWARD)
            val global=2
            val fw=RestrictedInitialPolicy(run=3,fieldLimit=global,direction=Direction.FORWARD,catalog=f.manager.marks)
            val bw=RestrictedInitialPolicy(run=4,fieldLimit=global,direction=Direction.BACKWARD,catalog=f.manager.marks)
            // Old backward make initial was ret.a.ANY: it is the next forward Dp.
            val makeDp=f.ops.leaves(oldWriter).single()
            val makeGuide=guide(f,pRoot,makeDp)
            val newWriterRaw=transfer(f,writerSeed,make,global,Direction.FORWARD)
            val newWriter=relative(f,makeGuide.intersect(f.key,writerSeed.initial,newWriterRaw,fw).single(),makeDp,global)
            assertEquals(Layer.NORMAL,newWriter.layer)
            assertEquals(2,f.ops.leaves(newWriter).single().fact.path.size)
            val takeDc=f.ops.leaves(oldReader).single()
            val takeGuide=guide(f,takeDc,retRoot)
            val takeInitial=takeGuide.initials(f.key,bind(f,newWriter,p,global),fw).single()
            val takeRaw=transfer(f,takeInitial,take,global,Direction.FORWARD)
            val takeResult=relative(f,takeGuide.intersect(f.key,takeInitial.initial,takeRaw,fw).single(),retRoot,global)
            assertEquals(2,takeInitial.initial.pathArray.size)
            assertEquals(Layer.NORMAL,takeResult.layer)
            // The symmetric backward publication can progress through Dp depth 1 too.
            val readerDp=f.ops.leaves(oldReader).single()
            val readerGuide=guide(f,retRoot,readerDp)
            val newReaderRaw=transfer(f,readerSeed,take.asReversed().map { revEdge(it)!! },global,Direction.BACKWARD)
            val newReader=relative(f,readerGuide.intersect(f.key,readerSeed.initial,newReaderRaw,bw).single(),readerDp,global)
            assertEquals(Layer.NORMAL,newReader.layer)
            val makeBackGuide=guide(f,f.ops.leaves(oldWriter).single(),pRoot)
            val makeInitial=makeBackGuide.initials(f.key,bind(f,newReader,ret,global),bw).single()
            val makeBackRaw=transfer(f,makeInitial,make.asReversed().map { revEdge(it)!! },global,Direction.BACKWARD)
            val makeBack=relative(f,makeBackGuide.intersect(f.key,makeInitial.initial,makeBackRaw,bw).single(),pRoot,global)
            assertEquals(Layer.NORMAL,makeBack.layer)
            println("PAIR_PROGRESS global=$global writerOriginDepth=0 makeDpDepth=${makeDp.fact.path.size} writer=${desc(f,newWriter)} takeInitialDepth=${takeInitial.initial.pathArray.size} sinkResult=${desc(f,takeResult)} readerOriginDepth=0 readerDpDepth=${readerDp.fact.path.size} reader=${desc(f,newReader)} makeInitialDepth=${makeInitial.initial.pathArray.size} sourceResult=${desc(f,makeBack)} nativeReplayUsed=false")
        }
    }
}
